record.label: Odd symmetry and endpoint values
record.statement: The circuit uses the odd symmetry of arcsin and treats the endpoints separately from the polynomial approximation on the interior.
record.boundary: At $+1$, the proof bounds the error between $13{,}176{,}795/2^{23}$ and $\pi/2$. At $-1$, it uses the oddness of $\arcsin$ to relate the error to the same bounds on $\pi$.
